page_title: JUV 1-1 SAL | Juventus v Salernitana 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Toma Basic (Salernitana) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
90+7' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
90+3' Alberto Santoro shows the yellow card to Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana) for a heavy challenge.
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:1.
90+1' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana) is replacing Junior Sambia.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Stefano Colantuono decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli will be replaced by Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana).
89' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
88' A yellow card is awarded to Vincenzo Fiorillo (Salernitana).
88' It should have been a goal! Fabio Miretti (Juventus) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
86' The ball rebounds out to Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
85' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) picked up a yellow card from referee.
84' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
83' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
81' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

80' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Vincenzo Fiorillo is prepared and leaps to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
80' The free kick into the penalty area from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is cleared.
79' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Juventus.
77' Today's match ends for Daniele Rugani who will be replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
77' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
75' Salernitana can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' It's time for a substitution. Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) comes on in place of Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi.
73' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dusan Vlahovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
71' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
68' Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Alberto Santoro ignores the protests.
68' Federico Gatti (Juventus) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
66' Federico Gatti (Juventus) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands.
65' A substitution has been made. Emanuel Vignato is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
65' Toma Basic (Salernitana) makes a slide tackle, but referee Alberto Santoro blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Juventus.
63' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

63' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.

62' What a chance! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.

60' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
59' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

59' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
58' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

56' What an opportunity! Federico Fazio (Salernitana) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
55' A clumsy foul by Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) and Alberto Santoro blows his whistle.
54' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alberto Santoro who sees an offensive foul.
53' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
49' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends it out of play.
49' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

46' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Vincenzo Fiorillo!
46' The substitution has been made. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) has replaced Weston McKennie.
46' Here is a change. Filip Kostic is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
46' The substitution is prepared. Federico Chiesa (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moise Kean.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Alberto Santoro blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+2' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a long ball in, but Vincenzo Fiorillo comfortably gathers the ball.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Filip Kostic (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
44' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was!
42' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
41' Alberto Santoro interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Toma Basic (Salernitana).
40' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Weston McKennie (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
40' The ball is cleared after Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Moise Kean (Juventus), but the defence gets it clear.

36' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a comfortable save.
35' It looked like the long-range shot by Bremer (Juventus) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
34' The game is interrupted now, Junior Sambia (Salernitana) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
32' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Wojciech Szczesny to dive and make a save.
31' Alberto Santoro has a clear sight and sees a foul from Federico Gatti (Juventus). Salernitana have a free kick from a promising distance.
29' Moise Kean (Juventus) is adjudged offside.
27' 0 - 1 Gooal! Junior Sambia takes over corner duties. Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
26' The referee awards a corner and Junior Sambia (Salernitana) goes over to take it.
25' The foul by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alberto Santoro.
24' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Filip Kostic.
23' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Alberto Santoro shows a yellow card to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) for a tough tackle.
21' Flag goes up against Weston McKennie (Juventus) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
20' Filip Kostic (Juventus) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
19' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
18' Moise Kean (Juventus) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
17' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
16' Filip Kostic (Juventus) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
16' Filip Kostic (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Juventus win a corner.
16' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
14' Good clearance! Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
13' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is penalised for holding. Alberto Santoro signals a set piece.
10' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
10' The corner from Junior Sambia (Salernitana) is cleared away by the defence.
8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the roof of the net, but Vincenzo Fiorillo punched it onto the bar.
5' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
4' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Salernitana will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
